description: Optional local-first evaluation catalog, approval-aware plan, and deterministic evidence scoring runtime.

notes: This pack records eval evidence and promotion gates but does not mutate defaultspack provider entries.
Agent, IDE, and data-analysis packs may consume fit matrix outputs for routing decisions.
Provider keys are runtime-only requirements and must not appear in pack files.

base_pack_promotion.reason: Domain-specific evaluation policy pack; promotion decisions are advisory gates for defaultspack maintainers.

security_notes: No provider keys, API tokens, OAuth clients, private endpoints, or credentials are embedded.
Network default is none; provider smoke recipes require explicit runtime approval and externally supplied credentials.
The runtime plans but does not execute provider calls or grant authority.
